name: WYRM-BFS
note: Exhaustive breadth-first solver. Provably optimal play — the reference line every LLM is measured against. No API, no cost, deterministic.

name: GLM-4.6
note: Built-in sandbox model. Zero-config fallback brain of the arena.

name: Gemini 2.5 Flash (free tier)
note: Google AI Studio free tier — no credit card, generous daily caps. The zero-cost entry point for frontier-family models.

name: Llama 3.3 70B (Groq)
note: Groq free tier — no credit card, LPU-class speed. The arena's favourite free horsepower.

name: Llama 3.3 70B (Cerebras free)
note: Cerebras free tier — fastest tokens/sec on the planet, daily allowance. No credit card.

name: Mistral Small (Experiment tier)
note: Mistral La Plateforme Experiment tier — ~1B tokens/month free (1 req/s). Phone verification required.

name: OpenRouter :free pool
note: Any :free model on OpenRouter — one key, ~21 free models. Swap modelId freely.

name: Qwen 2.5 14B (Ollama)
note: Fully local, no key. Demonstrates the small-context path: the context fitter truncates history with a visible marker.

name: Any Model (MCP bridge)
note: ANY model reachable over MCP. apiKeyEnv must export WRYM_MCP_ENV='LLM_BASE_URL=http://localhost:11434/v1;LLM_MODEL=qwen2.5:14b' (or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint). Full guide: docs/MCP_SUPPORT.md. Test the chain with `bun scripts/test-mcp.ts`.
